items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: men like Johnnie Hodges, Barney Bigard, Harry Carney, Juan Tizol, Rex Stewart and Cootie Williams had ideas -- contributed them, often to head arrangements

ctx.x: No, I don't know anything about that.

In this section about the 1930's, Mercer says, 'When you look at the credits of his compositions (he means Duke's compositions from this period) you will see several of the side men credited as collaborators. None was probably so creative or prolific as Bubber Miley, but men like Johnnie Hodges, Barney Bigard, Harry Carney, Juan Tizol, Rex Stewart and Cootie Williams had ideas -- contributed them, often to head arrangements, and were credited.' Is that right?
